Package app.swea2

Class Goal

java.lang.Object
app.swea2.Goal
class Goal extends Object
Represents a user's savings target with a deadline.

Progress is tracked via updateProgress(BigDecimal), which automatically transitions the status to GoalStatus.COMPLETED when the target is reached or GoalStatus.CANCELLED when the deadline has passed.
